responsibility: Declares GCC’s structured optimization-information classes. It defines optinfo as a bundle of user/implementation location, pass identity, kind, profile count, and a sequence of typed optinfo_item payloads, plus enums for optinfo and item kinds and the helper for determining whether inlining metadata should be preserved. This header is the schema for data captured from dump_* calls before those records are emitted to dumps or optimization-record outputs.
same_name_distinction: This is the schema/header side of the optinfo group: it declares the optinfo and optinfo_item classes, their enums, and accessor APIs for structured optimization records. Unlike optinfo.cc, which implements destruction, item accumulation, and emission-related behavior, this header defines the data model consumed by dump and record emitters.
